svg.title: Every null is counted and retained. The positive square roots with a neutral pointer give the finite isometry V = P j pEj ⊗|j⟩, retaining output source and any inert reference. For degenerate modes a balanced rotation and a complete basis absorber realize γ = 1; known unsharpness permits other values. Nondegenerate energy modes require the phase-reference stock from the finite-reference model. No calibration phase resource is free. A hit has probability wηc, independent of setting. Its conditional Bernoulli parameters are p and q = (1 + γt)/2. This conditioning is justified by independent preparations and state-independent loss, not by a reset wave. Let nZ, nX be hit counts and KZ, KX the true counts of label 0, +. An adversary may change at most kZ, kX accepted labels, even after seeing all data, producing f KZ, f KX. Nulls cannot be forged, suppressed or selected. This is robustness of the nominated reported-count readout; no optimum over hidden corruption-controller records is asserted.
